title: How a factsheet PDF becomes a stored, displayable factsheet
purpose: Show the small 2-step pipeline that runs when the user uploads the course factsheet PDF: a Claude call cleans it into structured JSON, and a pure-Python renderer turns the JSON into student-facing Markdown. This is the simplest end-to-end example of the 10-line wrapper pattern used everywhere in the app.
audience: non-engineer teammates and the grading teacher

groups.label: Stage 1 — read the factsheet PDF (no AI)
Stage 2 — clean into structured JSON (Claude call)
Stage 4 — render for display (pure Python, no AI)

nodes.label: Factsheet PDF
nodes.description: Uploaded by the user when creating a class on the My Classes page

nodes.label: pdf_to_md_v3.extract_with_tables
nodes.description: Same converter the lecture pipeline uses — turns PDF into Markdown

nodes.label: factsheet_cleaner_system_prompt.md
nodes.description: Tells Claude how to extract a fixed JSON schema (core_course_content, assessment_and_grading, FSLO, surf_extraction_notes, etc.) from messy factsheet text

nodes.label: factsheet_cleaner.clean_factsheet
nodes.description: 10-line wrapper: load sibling .md as system prompt, send raw markdown as user message, expect JSON back

nodes.label: Cleaned factsheet JSON (strict schema)
nodes.description: This is the JSON the lecture pipeline later reads — its 7-key subset (D-1.2) is what gets passed to the LO extractor

nodes.label: queries_classes.insert_class
nodes.description: Stores the JSON inside one column (classes.factsheet_json) — no separate factsheet table

nodes.label: factsheet_renderer.render_factsheet
nodes.description: Pure Python — no API call. Turns cleaned JSON into student-facing Markdown. Empty subsections auto-hide. surf_extraction_notes is intentionally NOT rendered (internal-only, consumed by the LO extractor)

nodes.label: Student-facing factsheet Markdown
nodes.description: Shown on the Class Detail page

edges.description: Renderer reads the stored JSON when the Class Detail page loads

verification: Both stages of the pipeline are present: clean (AI) + render (pure Python)
The 'no AI in the renderer' fact is explicit — teacher should be able to see this is deterministic
The single-column JSON storage decision is shown (no separate factsheet table)
The link to the LO extractor's 7-key subset (D-1.2) is mentioned in the cleaned_json node description
The 10-line wrapper pattern is mentioned on the cleaner node description
